en.app.name: Rake
en.app.title: Rake — disk cleanup
en.app.scanningNote: This takes about half a minute. Nothing leaves your Mac.
en.app.summary: Rules can clean {all}. {regen} of it is cache that apps rebuild on their own.
en.app.noteEnough: The two groups above get you to {size}. You don't need the ones below.
en.app.noteShort: Even after the two groups above you'll have less than 20 G. These may help.
en.app.footDemo: Demo data. Nothing here touches your disk.
en.app.footLive: Scanned {time}. Only what you select is cleaned, after you see the list.
en.app.footDenied: {n} folders couldn't be read and were skipped.
en.app.footError: Couldn't read real data, showing demo data: {err}
en.app.tipInfo: Rake won't do this. Click to see why
en.app.tipSmall: Drawn larger than its real share so you can click it
en.app.planIntro: This is exactly what will happen, {size} in total. Nothing outside this list is touched.
en.app.methodTrash: Moved to the Trash (you can put it back)
en.app.planExpiry: This list is valid for 10 minutes. After that, build it again.
en.app.applyFailed: Something went wrong: {err}. Nothing outside the list was touched.
en.app.keepNote: Rake refuses to delete anything in these places, even if a rule points there.
en.kind.content: Your files: can't be recovered once deleted
en.kind.tools: Apps and tools: reinstall or redownload if deleted
en.kind.caches: Cache: apps rebuild it on their own
en.kind.unknown: Unclassified: no rule recognises it yet
en.why.docs: ~/Documents, ~/Desktop and ~/Downloads, minus old downloads listed separately.
en.why.code: Other visible folders in your home folder, such as projects.
en.why.chat: Messages, WeChat, Telegram, Slack, Discord and Lark data. Clean them inside each app.
en.why.dot: Hidden folders in your home folder: settings and data of developer tools.
en.why.llm: Model files from Hugging Face, Ollama and LM Studio.
en.why.sys: System, Preboot and Recovery volumes. Managed by macOS.
en.why.sysdata: /Library, /private/var and /Users/Shared. Some parts need admin rights to read.
en.why.unk: Used space no rule explains: local snapshots, other users, folders Rake can't read.
en.rule.upd.label: App update packages
en.rule.upd.why: Updates that apps downloaded and already installed (Sparkle, ShipIt, *-updater). Anything changed in the last 6 hours is skipped.
en.rule.crx.label: Chrome extension updates
en.rule.crx.why: Extension packages Google Updater downloaded. Chrome fetches them again when needed.
en.rule.vsix.label: VS Code extension installers
en.rule.vsix.why: Installer files left after VS Code installed extensions.
en.rule.ext.label: Old editor extensions
en.rule.ext.why: Only old versions that a newer installed version replaced. Extensions you installed by hand are left alone.
en.rule.npm.label: npm cache
en.rule.npm.why: Download cache of npm. Same as npm cache clean --force.
en.rule.pip.label: pip cache
en.rule.pip.why: Download cache of pip. Same as pip cache purge.
en.rule.uv.label: uv cache
en.rule.uv.why: Package cache of uv. Same as uv cache clean. Projects keep their own copies.
en.rule.brew.label: Homebrew cache
en.rule.brew.why: Downloaded bottles and installers in Homebrew's cache. Installed packages are not touched.
en.rule.dl.label: Old large downloads
en.rule.dl.why: Items in Downloads over 150 MB that haven't changed in 30 days. They go to the Trash, so you can still put them back.
en.rule.trash.label: Trash
en.rule.trash.why: Files you already deleted. Rake doesn't empty the Trash. Check it in Finder, then choose Empty Trash.
en.rule.swap.label: Swap
en.rule.swap.why: Memory macOS moved to disk: {used} used, Mac up for {days} days. Only a restart gives it back.
en.rule.mid.label: Old macOS installer
en.rule.mid.why: Leftovers from an earlier macOS upgrade. Removing them needs an admin password.
en.keep.cloud.why: Files here may exist only in the cloud copy.
en.keep.folders.why: Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Library and the like. What's inside can be cleaned, the folders themselves can't.
en.keep.system.why: /System, /usr and anything outside your home folder.
en.keep.links.why: A link whose target is outside your home folder.
en.guard.ancestor: a folder that contains your home folder
en.guard.toplevel: a top-level folder in your home
en.guard.link: a link that points outside your home folder
en.site.title: Rake — free, open source disk cleanup for Mac
en.site.description: See where your Mac's space went, read the exact list, then clean. Free, open source, runs offline.
en.site.h1: See where the space went. Then clean.
en.site.sub: Rake draws your disk as one map, tells you which parts are safe to clean, and shows the exact list before anything is touched.
en.site.meta: v{v} · macOS 13+ · Apple silicon and Intel · Free and open source
en.site.first.b1: Rake isn't signed with a paid Apple developer certificate, so macOS asks before opening it the first time.
en.site.first.b2: On macOS 15 and later: open Rake once, close the warning, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
en.site.first.b3: On macOS 13 and 14: right-click Rake in Applications and choose Open.
en.site.first.curl: The Terminal command downloads Rake.dmg from GitHub Releases, copies Rake into /Applications and ejects the disk image. Files downloaded by curl don't carry the quarantine flag, so macOS doesn't show the warning. It never asks for your password.
en.site.first.perm: When Rake first reads Desktop, Documents or Downloads, macOS asks for access. If you say no, those folders are skipped and counted as unclassified.
en.site.footer: MIT License · Made with SwiftUI · Source on GitHub
en.app.toastTrashed: {size} went to the Trash. You can put it back in Finder. Empty the Trash to free that space.
en.app.summaryEmpty: Nothing left for the rules to clean.
en.site.first.shotAlt: System Settings, Privacy & Security: "Rake.app" was blocked, with an Open Anyway button
en.site.video.alt: A 34-second video: Rake maps a full disk, you tick what's safe, review the list, and get 8.4 GB back.
en.site.pain.cap: used. By what? You can't see it, so you don't dare touch it.
en.site.see.b: Rake draws your whole disk as one map.
en.site.see.dark: Dark stones · Your files. Gone if deleted.
en.site.see.light: Light stones · Caches. Apps rebuild them.
en.site.tick.lab: Cache · npm rebuilds it on its own
en.site.tick.alt: Rake's map with five caches ticked, 8.4 GB in total, and a button to clean them
en.site.check.b: The exact list. Nothing else is touched.
en.site.check.alt: The review list: five cache paths and their sizes, 8.4 GB in total, cleaned only after you confirm
en.site.result.cap: Caches go. Everything else waits in the Trash.
en.site.three.offline.b: Runs on your Mac. Rake has no network code.
en.site.three.free.b: No account, no trial, no upgrade screen.
en.site.three.open.b: MIT licensed. Read every line on GitHub.

zh-Hans.app.name: Rake
zh-Hans.app.title: Rake 磁盘清理
zh-Hans.app.scanningNote: 大约半分钟。数据不出这台 Mac。
zh-Hans.app.summary: 规则能清 {all}。其中 {regen} 是缓存，删了会自己再生。
zh-Hans.app.noteEnough: 上面两档做完就有 {size}，够用，下面这些不建议动。
zh-Hans.app.noteShort: 上面两档做完仍不到 20 G，可以看看下面这些。
zh-Hans.app.footDemo: 演示数据，不会碰你的磁盘。
zh-Hans.app.footLive: 扫描于 {time}。只清你勾选的，清之前先看清单。
zh-Hans.app.footDenied: {n} 个文件夹读不到，已跳过。
zh-Hans.app.footError: 读不到真实数据，显示演示数据：{err}
zh-Hans.app.tipInfo: Rake 不替你做，点一下看原因
zh-Hans.app.tipSmall: 按比例应更小，这里放大显示，方便点
zh-Hans.app.planIntro: 下面就是会发生的全部操作，一共 {size}。清单以外的东西不会碰。
zh-Hans.app.methodRemove: 直接删除（缓存，应用会重建）
zh-Hans.app.methodTrash: 移到废纸篓（还能放回原处）
zh-Hans.app.planExpiry: 这份清单 10 分钟内有效，过期要重新生成。
zh-Hans.app.applyFailed: 出错了：{err}。清单以外的东西没有碰。
zh-Hans.app.keepNote: 就算规则指到这些地方，Rake 也拒绝删除。
zh-Hans.kind.tools: 应用与工具：删了要重装或重下
zh-Hans.why.code: 主目录下其余可见的文件夹，比如各个项目。
zh-Hans.why.chat: 信息、微信、Telegram、Slack、Discord、飞书的数据。要清就在各自的应用里清。
zh-Hans.why.dot: 主目录下的隐藏目录：各种开发工具的配置和数据。
zh-Hans.why.llm: Hugging Face、Ollama、LM Studio 的模型文件。
zh-Hans.why.sys: System、Preboot、Recovery 等卷，由 macOS 管理。
zh-Hans.why.sysdata: /Library、/private/var、/Users/Shared。部分目录要管理员权限才读得到。
zh-Hans.why.unk: 规则解释不了的已用空间：本地快照、其他用户、Rake 读不到的文件夹。
zh-Hans.rule.upd.label: 应用更新包
zh-Hans.rule.upd.why: 各应用下载并已装好的更新包（Sparkle、ShipIt、*-updater）。6 小时内改动过的跳过。
zh-Hans.rule.crx.label: Chrome 扩展更新包
zh-Hans.rule.crx.why: Google Updater 下载的扩展安装包。需要时 Chrome 会再下。
zh-Hans.rule.vsix.label: VS Code 扩展安装包
zh-Hans.rule.vsix.why: VS Code 装完扩展后留下的安装包。
zh-Hans.rule.ext.label: 旧版编辑器扩展
zh-Hans.rule.ext.why: 只删已被新版本替换的旧版本。你手动装的扩展不动。
zh-Hans.rule.npm.label: npm 缓存
zh-Hans.rule.npm.why: npm 的下载缓存。效果同 npm cache clean --force。
zh-Hans.rule.pip.label: pip 缓存
zh-Hans.rule.pip.why: pip 的下载缓存。效果同 pip cache purge。
zh-Hans.rule.uv.label: uv 缓存
zh-Hans.rule.uv.why: uv 的包缓存。效果同 uv cache clean。项目各自有副本。
zh-Hans.rule.brew.label: Homebrew 缓存
zh-Hans.rule.brew.why: Homebrew 缓存里下载过的 bottle 和安装包。已装的软件不动。
zh-Hans.rule.dl.label: 下载里的旧大文件
zh-Hans.rule.dl.why: 下载文件夹里超过 150 MB、30 天没改过的项。会移到废纸篓，还能放回原处。
zh-Hans.rule.trash.label: 废纸篓
zh-Hans.rule.trash.why: 你已经删过一次的文件。Rake 不替你清倒，先在访达里看一眼，再选「清倒废纸篓」。
zh-Hans.rule.swap.label: swap
zh-Hans.rule.swap.why: macOS 换到磁盘上的内存：已用 {used}，开机 {days} 天。只有重启能收回。
zh-Hans.rule.mid.label: 旧系统安装残留
zh-Hans.rule.mid.why: 以前升级 macOS 留下的。删除要管理员密码。
zh-Hans.keep.cloud: iCloud 云盘和云同步文件夹
zh-Hans.keep.cloud.why: 这里的文件可能只有云端那一份。
zh-Hans.keep.folders.why: 桌面、文稿、下载、图片、资源库等。里面的东西可以清，文件夹本身不删。
zh-Hans.keep.links.why: 目标在主目录以外的链接。
zh-Hans.guard.ancestor: 包含主目录的上层目录
zh-Hans.guard.toplevel: 主目录下的一级文件夹
zh-Hans.guard.link: 指向主目录以外的链接
zh-Hans.site.title: Rake：免费开源的 Mac 磁盘清理
zh-Hans.site.description: 一张图看清 Mac 的空间去哪了，看完清单再清。免费开源，不联网。
zh-Hans.site.h1: 先看清空间去哪了，再清。
zh-Hans.site.sub: Rake 把整块盘画成一张图，告诉你哪些能放心清，动手之前先给你看完整清单。
zh-Hans.site.meta: v{v} · macOS 13+ · Apple 芯片和 Intel · 免费开源
zh-Hans.site.first.b1: Rake 没有用付费的 Apple 开发者证书签名，所以第一次打开时 macOS 会先拦一下。
zh-Hans.site.first.b2: macOS 15 及以上：先打开一次 Rake，关掉提示，再去「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」，点「仍要打开」。
zh-Hans.site.first.b3: macOS 13 和 14：在「应用程序」里右键 Rake，选「打开」。
zh-Hans.site.first.curl: 终端命令会从 GitHub Releases 下载 Rake.dmg，把 Rake 复制到 /Applications，再推出磁盘映像。curl 下载的文件不带隔离标记，所以 macOS 不弹提示。整个过程不要密码。
zh-Hans.site.first.perm: Rake 第一次读桌面、文稿、下载时，macOS 会问你要不要允许。选不允许，这些文件夹就跳过，算进未归类。
zh-Hans.site.footer: MIT 协议 · 用 SwiftUI 写成 · 源码在 GitHub
zh-Hans.app.toastTrashed: {size} 移进了废纸篓，可以在访达里放回。清倒废纸篓后这部分空间才会腾出。
zh-Hans.site.first.shotAlt: 系统设置的隐私与安全性：已阻止“Rake.app”，旁边是「仍要打开」按钮
zh-Hans.site.video.alt: 34 秒视频：Rake 画出整块磁盘，勾选可清的部分，核对清单，腾出 8.4 GB。
zh-Hans.site.pain.cap: 被什么占了？看不见，就不敢动。
zh-Hans.site.see.b: Rake 把整块磁盘画成一张图。
zh-Hans.site.see.dark: 深色石头 · 你的文件，删了就没了。
zh-Hans.site.see.light: 浅色石头 · 缓存，App 会自己重建。
zh-Hans.site.tick.lab: 缓存 · npm 会自己重建
zh-Hans.site.tick.alt: Rake 的卵石图：勾选了 5 项缓存，共 8.4 GB，下方是清理按钮
zh-Hans.site.check.b: 就是这张清单，别的一概不动。
zh-Hans.site.check.alt: 审阅清单：5 条缓存路径和大小，共 8.4 GB，确认后才清
zh-Hans.site.result.cap: 缓存直接删，其余进废纸篓。
zh-Hans.site.three.offline.b: 在本机运行。Rake 里没有联网代码。
zh-Hans.site.three.free.b: 不用注册，没有试用期，没有升级弹窗。
zh-Hans.site.three.open.b: MIT 协议。每一行代码都在 GitHub 上。
